items.a_line_assessment: RemoteCommandExecutor::ptrChannel_ has an unsynchronized setter/getter pair and is also written by CreateChannelIfNeeded and read while commands execute. The executor mutex covers only part of the owner accesses; concurrent device-online and command-processing paths remain a realistic race shape.
a_line_missing_facts: Exact thread/event-runner ownership for NotifyDeviceOnline, GetExecutorChannel, and command execution.
